resources.string: Choose the privilege source for rear screen control. End casting, close recording controls, and wait for screenshots or other operations before switching.
Your phone must be rooted. Allow this app in your root manager to control the rear screen directly.
The independent Root control service is connected.
End rear screen casting, close recording controls, and wait for the current operation to finish before switching.
The previous control service could not finish cleanup. Try again later.
The control service is not ready. Open ReMRSS to check the selected privilege source and connect.
Rear screen control uses the selected privilege source. Root mode requires permission for this app in your root manager.

Alternatively, select Privilege source → Root on the home connection card, tap the authorization button, and allow the installed ReMRSS app in your root manager. Release and debug apps need separate authorization. You can switch back to Shizuku manually. End active casting, recording and screenshots before switching.
